response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(cr.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS result_count FROM constructorResults AS cr JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId WHERE cr.points > 1.0 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name), with_name_avg AS (SELECT per_race.*, AVG(avg_points) OVER (PARTITION BY name) AS name_avg_points FROM per_race) SELECT raceId, name, avg_points, result_count, avg_points / NULLIF(name_avg_points, 0) AS ratio FROM with_name_avg ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST, raceId LIMIT 10;
